title: CratesBump: A Version-Bump Dataset for the Rust Ecosystem
abstract: arXiv:2611.23664v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We release CratesBump, the first public dataset for predicting version bumps in the Rust ecosystem, together with semver-extract, the tool that builds it. CratesBump is built from every crate on crates.io with at least two releases before 14 September 2026 (about 220,000 crates), giving over two million consecutive release pairs. Each pair has 41 features (code changes from AST diffs, dependency changes, complexity, release cadence, GitHub commit and issue activity), its source repository where listed, and two labels: the literal reading of MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, and Cargo's rule, under which a 0.y bump is a breaking change. semver-extract regenerates the dataset from public crates.io data and the GitHub API. To illustrate its use we (i) benchmark bump predictors on held-out repositories, finding the task learnable but far from solved, with lower scores on later releases; (ii) measure which feature groups carry the signal; (iii) check, aga

translated_title: CratesBump：面向 Rust 生态系统的版本升级数据集
translated_abstract: 我们发布了 CratesBump，这是首个用于预测 Rust 生态系统中版本升级的公开数据集，同时发布了构建该数据集的工具 semver-extract。CratesBump 由 crates.io 上在 2026 年 9 月 14 日之前至少发布过两个版本的每个 crate（约 22 万个 crate）构建而成，提供了超过两百万个连续发布对。每个发布对包含 41 个特征（基于 AST 差异的代码变更、依赖变更、复杂度、发布节奏、GitHub 提交与 issue 活跃度）、其源代码仓库（如有列出），以及两个标签：对 MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH 的字面解读，以及 Cargo 的规则——按照该规则，0.y 版本的升级属于破坏性变更（breaking change）。semver-extract 可以基于公开的 crates.io 数据和 GitHub API 重新生成该数据集。为了展示其用途，我们（i）在留出的仓库上对版本升级预测器进行基准测试，发现该任务是可学习的但远未解决，且在较新的版本上得分更低；（ii）测量哪些特征组携带有效信号；（iii）检验……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发布了首个用于预测 Rust 生态系统版本升级的公开数据集 CratesBump（涵盖约 22 万个 crate、超过两百万个连续发布对、每对含 41 个特征和双重标签），并配套提供可从公开数据重新生成该数据集的工具 semver-extract，基准实验表明版本升级预测任务可学习但远未解决。
